entries.speaker: Third-Year Group Leader
entries.en: Hey, that guy—yeah, him. Is he...[n]THAT transfer student?

entries.speaker: First-Year Group Member
entries.en: You mean the one in all the crazy rumors?

entries.speaker: Third-Year Group Leader
entries.en: Keep it down! What if he hears us!?

entries.speaker: Testy First-Year
entries.en: Ugh. Anyone who just dumps a broken[n]umbrella on the ground like this is[n]human garbage.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, before you trash it, you have to[n]make sure you separate the plastic[n]parts from the metal frame.

entries.speaker: Brunette Third-Year
entries.en: I had no idea you knew about that[n]kinda stuff, Takamaki-san. I bet[n]you'd make a wonderful wife.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wait—shouldn't we take[n]that to a police box?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Man, this park is trashed... No way this[n]was all done by kids—it's gotta be the[n]work of some no-good adults, too.

entries.speaker: Mature Third-Year
entries.en: If you don't mind, may I have the cap[n]on that bottle?

entries.speaker: Mature Third-Year
entries.en: Recycling companies collect these and[n]convert them into vials for vaccines.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Well, that sounds like an awesome way[n]to bring more justice to the world!

entries.speaker: Mature Third-Year
entries.en: ...I'm sorry, but I'm not sure I follow you.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Before I add taro to the pot, I have[n]to rub them with salt to reduce the[n]sliminess...

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I do cook pretty often at home.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Let me try this little technique here...

entries.speaker: Thin Female Student
entries.en: Huh? What the... Why's the wind salty!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: The cleanup is officially complete.[n]Thank you for your hard work,[n]everyone.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Would the leader of each group[n]please come and get the soup[n]for their teams?

entries.speaker: Third-Year Group Leader
entries.en: So, after the soup's doled out, everyone's[n]free to do whatever they want.

entries.speaker: Third-Year Group Leader
entries.en: Including getting the hell outta here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't know the best way to put it...[n]but that sure was a crappy time out[n]there.

entries.speaker: Student Called Yoshizawa
entries.en: I was trying to find you so I could[n]thank you properly for this morning.

entries.speaker: Student Called Yoshizawa
entries.en: So... Where'd the other people in your[n]group go?

entries.speaker: Student Called Yoshizawa
entries.en: If it's all right with you, why don't[n]we eat our soup together?
